issues.reason: Degree is defined as (Degree <entity> <scale> <level>) over an adjectival scale and has no event form — the reviewer's own gap 1 — while the oblique list literally licenses 'Manner (adverb)', so the surface adverb on the event is true of the content and well-typed improvisation in gap territory.

Same calibration: (Measure e duration n unit) needs a number, 'briefly' supplies none, and the extent-of-the-eventuality reading recorded by the surface adverb in Manner is true and well-typed — unlike a phasal/discourse particle, which the aspectual section separately bars from Manner.

The parse is in exactly the licensed change-of-state resultative shape — the subject is the weaken event's Patient, the resulting eventuality is reified with that same subject as Experiencer, and Result links them ('The depot turned into a museum' pattern); the do-not-normalize rule governs inter-clause connectives, and the purpose head To would be worse here, since seeded rules derive PurposeOf from it and the currency did not weaken in order to trade.

'A non-finite embedded eventuality carries no tense/status atom of its own unless its own grammar marks one', and the reified result state takes none either (the fence/white example has no Past on sk_white_1), so (Past sk_trade_1) asserts occurrence the construction leaves unstated.

The content loss is real, but bid/ask notation has no licensed carrier (the reviewer's own gap 5) and the retained 55.34 is not false, so this is a gap rather than a repairable defect — reconstructing '/39' as 55.39 would be inference, and a second bare At atom would assert two simultaneous trade levels.

The proximity relation is indeed unrecorded (no small-difference or negated-distance relation exists in the vocabulary), but 'dropped entirely' overstates it — the record low, its genus decomposition, its possessor and its 55.75 value are all emitted; only the link to the 55.34 level is missing.

gaps_confirmed: degree/extent adverb on a VERB ('weakened slightly') — Degree needs an entity plus an adjectival scale
duration adverb with no measured amount ('briefly') — Measure duration needs a number and unit
result/outcome infinitive ('weakened ... to trade at X') — the only licensed 'to V' head is the purpose infinitive, whose seeded PurposeOf derivation would misreport it
bare numeric price/quote with no unit word — Measure requires a unit, so the value can only ride a preposition-named oblique
bid/ask quote notation ('55.34/39') — a compressed two-value pair with no representation
proximity / near-comparison between two values ('not far from X') — More / MoreBy / SameDegree / Degree offer no small-difference relation
repair_summary: Removed (Past sk_trade_1): 'to trade at 55.34/39' is a non-finite embedded eventuality (and, read as the resultative's reified state, a state witness), and neither takes a tense atom of its own.
notes: Three of the six issues object to graceful improvisation in territory the reviewer itself lists as uncovered, and the calibration line refutes those; the only atom that asserts more than the text states is the tense on the infinitive. The two Manner atoms are the first thing a future duration/degree operator should reclaim.
